sections.brief: Measure-by-measure ledger across Parts 1-20 with each part's source and definition: one big compare table (area | measure | US | Israel | direction since ~1980/2000 | part) and prose by cluster (state and rights; money and work; cost of living and housing; health, education, family; security and the aid), per-measure judgments only, no total; both countries' gaps (Israel: 5.56m under control without citizenship, Arab-community killings, housing, Haredi exemption; US: health coverage and cost, guns, incarceration, cost of living). Figures: compare

The aid in the ledger's light (2016 MOU $3.3bn FMF + $500m; military money spent mostly in the US, OSP 26.3% to zero FY2028; frees at most the grant, NIS 22bn contingent income, Gazit's cost, loan-guarantee deductions; 12.7% of GDP 1985 -> 0.6% 2025, ~24% -> 14-15% of defence, 0.05% of US outlays, ~$2.7bn in 2016 prices); claims tested (health care, aid as cause, Iron Dome, one-way money, poverty rates, health 3.3x, growth, hours, police exchanges, medical bankruptcy; corrections); what the comparison does and does not show (systems not peoples; coverage; definitions; snapshots vs series; no causal or overall verdict); open as of Oct 2026 (27 Oct and 3 Nov elections, court cases, Section 702, MOU successor); answer stated per measure.
